title: mineflayer-pathfinder index.js — path status, reset reasons and stop semantics
content_excerpt: A* results carry status 'partial', 'timeout', 'noPath' or 'success'. resetPath(reason) clears the current path and emits path_reset with reasons goal_updated, movements_updated, block_updated, chunk_loaded, goal_moved, dig_error, no_scaffolding_blocks, place_error and stuck. stop() clears the goal, empties the path, emits path_stop and calls fullStop(). A futility check resets with 'stuck' when more than 3500 ms elapsed without reaching the next node. thinkTimeout defaults to 5000 ms and tickTimeout to 40 ms.
evidence_notes: path_reset 的 reason 是区分“环境变化导致重算”和“真卡死”的关键诊断字段；stuck 有明确的 3500 ms 单节点阈值，可直接作为卡死判定基线。stop() 会清空目标，不能当作“已到达”。
related_game_versions: mineflayer-pathfinder 主线（与 mineflayer 支持版本同步）
notes: 阈值（3500 ms / 5000 ms）是库默认值，服务端延迟高时需要重新标定。
